Centering the Unit 2 bathroom door does not change Unit 3's kitchen layout or its clearance constraint relative to the Unit 3 bathroom door.
The Unit 2 bathroom-door instruction does not change the inclusion or assignment of the Unit 1 common bathroom.
The door-position change explicitly targets bathroom No. 2 and does not alter the Unit 3 bathroom requirement.

The same message separately updates toilet positioning relative to existing drains, and that instruction is already represented by the candidate's message-41 MODIFY; centering the Unit 2 bathroom door adds no further drainage-state change.
The Unit 2 bathroom-door position does not affect Unit 1's kitchen configuration or cabinet dimensions.
Centering a bathroom door does not necessarily change the established partition-wall construction or demolition requirements.
The bathroom-door change is unrelated to the common entrance and independent dwelling entrance doors.

The initial concept sketch already requires bathroom positions generally; the later Unit 2 door detail does not necessarily revise that task-local artifact's defined content.
